source: Positions: SIMBAD. Masses and distances: discovery papers (verified against arXiv abstracts).

objects.name: Gaia BH1
objects.about: The nearest known black hole: a dormant 9.6 M☉ black hole orbited by a Sun-like star.

objects.name: Gaia BH2
objects.about: A dormant black hole orbited by a red giant.

objects.name: Gaia BH3
objects.about: The most massive stellar black hole known in the Milky Way.

objects.name: Cygnus X-1
objects.about: The first black hole ever identified (1971), feeding on a blue supergiant companion.
objects.distanceNote: Distance from Miller-Jones et al. 2021 (Science 371, 1046), not this abstract.

objects.name: V404 Cygni
objects.about: An X-ray binary whose distance was the first measured to a black hole by parallax.

objects.name: A0620-00
objects.about: One of the nearest black holes, in an X-ray binary in Monoceros.

objects.name: Vela Pulsar
objects.about: A young pulsar spinning 11 times a second, left by a supernova about 11,000 years ago.

objects.name: PSR J0437-4715
objects.about: The nearest millisecond pulsar, spinning 174 times a second.
